title: At 78, Nashville songwriter Jerry Vandiver rescues foxes with mange; 60+ treated this year
summary_full: In a heartwarming display of compassion, Nashville songwriter Jerry Vandiver has devoted himself to rescuing sick red foxes. He skillfully traps these ailing creatures, transporting them to Walden’s Puddle Wildlife Center for much-needed care. In August alone, his dedication earned him 234 volunteer hours, ultimately assisting numerous animals. Through his efforts, he ensures that these foxes can heal and safely return to their natural environments.
